calibration_note: Hand-authored floor, not measured: this sandbox has no live Qdrant to run scripts/run_benchmark.py against (same environmental limitation recorded in every prior offline-observability handoff this session). safety_pass_rate, avg_cost_usd, and failure_rate are set to their true expected values (BasicSecurityGuard's regex matching is deterministic and exact; DeterministicGenerator now explicitly records a real, measured cost_usd=0.0 rather than leaving it unmeasured -- Codex review pass 1, HIGH-003; the golden set's 13 cases are all expected to run to completion, so a 0.0 failure_rate is the real expectation, not a placeholder -- Codex review pass 1, HIGH-001) -- a real regression on any of these three would still be caught today. Every other quality metric is a deliberately lenient floor (catches a catastrophic regression -- retrieval or generation totally broken -- not a modest one) until a maintainer runs `python scripts/run_benchmark.py --update-baseline` once against a real Qdrant and replaces this file with the pipeline's actual measured numbers. See docs/guides/offline-evaluation.md.
